scope: Structured extracted images/documents and locations through durable V2 admission

contract.coordinates: finite and range-validated; no timezone override

admission.invalidEvidence: certified no-effect rejection before engine dispatch

authorization.caption: conservative direct ES/EN instruction grants; quoted spans and negated commands excluded
authorization.writes: one successful/partial operation for one unambiguous domain, plus observed-owned-reference checks and lease-bound host policy
authorization.validationFailures: may self-correct before first successful write
authorization.unsupportedOrAmbiguousCaption: clarification or subsequent explicit text required

conversation.memoryQueries: authored caption only; attachment-only semantic lookup omitted
conversation.automaticMemoryLearning: unchanged, delivered V2 turns skip operational extraction

validation.budgetComparison: same offline 1800/2500 capacity comparison still passes; production unchanged

limits: Extraction has its own upstream model/provider request and separate token accounting
No binary multimodal reasoning or retrieval of omitted document ranges
Caption grammar is conservative and is not full semantic/bulk attachment parity
Memory mutations/extraction and non-productivity tool parity remain before V1 retirement
Approval and unsupported-media lifecycles remain explicit retirement gates
rollback: Revert this media-ingress work unit including contract/builder, webhook and canary options, caption grants/prompt and loop write cap together; previous continuity and native productivity services remain independent.
